# porkbun_email_forward (Resource)

Manages an email forward for a domain. Porkbun identifies a forward by `address` plus `forward_to`; every argument forces replacement.

Adding a forward sets Porkbun's MX records and SPF include at the zone apex of the domain's Porkbun DNS. If that would delete other apex MX records or rewrite an existing SPF record, creation fails unless `confirm_dns_changes` is `true`. Deleting the last forward of a domain also removes Porkbun's forwarding MX and SPF records; this cannot be opted out of.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porkbun_email_forward" "hello" {
  domain     = "example.com"
  address    = "hello" # the part before the @
  forward_to = "me@example.org"
}

# Allow Porkbun to delete other apex MX records and rewrite an existing SPF
# record when setting up forwarding.
resource "porkbun_email_forward" "info" {
  domain              = "example.com"
  address             = "info"
  forward_to          = "me@example.org"
  confirm_dns_changes = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The address to forward: the part before the `@` (`hello`) or the whole address (`hello@example.com`). Both forms are treated as the same address.
- `domain` (String) <span style="color:red">(Force new)</span> The domain to forward email for.
- `forward_to` (String) <span style="color:red">(Force new)</span> The mailbox to deliver to.

### Optional

- `confirm_dns_changes` (Boolean) Agree to the DNS changes Porkbun needs to make at the zone apex, such as deleting other MX records or rewriting an existing SPF record. When `false` (the default) and confirmation is required, creation fails and lists the changes. This only affects creation and is not read back from the API. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porkbun_email_forward.example <domain>/<address>/<forward_to>

terraform import porkbun_email_forward.example example.com/hello/me@example.org
```
